usageEvidence.finding: Figurative hurdle denotes a problem to deal with before progress; does not by itself endorse the cooking example as a formal prerequisite.

Dictionary idiom specifies pressure on a person to make them act, which the cinematic suspense source does not establish.
Published usage of draw a line around your time and energy supports phrase naturalness; fixed-unit course value still unproven.
